focusAreas.#Appraisal: A set of terms typically used in various appraisal forms, for example, agency forms and the GSE's Uniform Appraisal Dataset (UAD).
focusAreas.#ArtificialIntelligence: A set of terms approved by the MISMO Artificial Intelligence Community of Practice.
focusAreas.#ClosingDisclosure: A set of terms typically used in loan closing disclosures, for example, the Loan Estimate, Closing Disclosure, or datapoints from the GSE Uniform Closing Dataset (UCD).
focusAreas.#Commercial: A set of terms, processes or documents as it relates to the mortgage business where the loan is secured by non-residential income producing property.
focusAreas.#CreditReporting: A set of terms from the MISMO Reference Model, grouped by the Credit Reporting Community of Practice.
focusAreas.#DGMFitForPurpose: A set of terms grouped by the MISMO Data Governance & Management (DGM) Fit For Purpose Framework artifact.
focusAreas.#LDD: A set of terms grouped by the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD) data points.
focusAreas.#LoanApplication: A set of terms that comprise the mapping of each Uniform Residential Loan Application (URLA) field to supporting MISMO v3.4 fields.
focusAreas.#LoanDelivery: A set of terms typically used in a Loan Delivery transaction, for example, datapoints from the GSE Uniform Loan Delivery Dataset (ULDD).
focusAreas.#MBAGlossary: A set of terms included in the Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA) Business Glossary.
focusAreas.#MISMOApprovedAcronym: A set of acronyms that have been approved for use within a MISMO data point name, definition or enumeration.
focusAreas.#MISMOLifeOfLoan: A set of terms grouped by the MISMO products and their relationship to “typical” processes within the mortgage lifecycle.
focusAreas.#Origination: A set of terms, processes or documents related to the completion of the residential or commercial mortgage application.
focusAreas.#Secondary: A set of terms, processes or documents related to developing mortgage products to originate, managing interest rate risk, setting pricing, and executing the sale, securitization, or retention of mortgage loans in a way that optimizes liquidity, profitability, and balance sheet efficiency.
focusAreas.#Servicing: A set of terms, processes or documents related to the following mortgage banking functions: receipts of payments, customer service, escrow administration, investor accounting, collections and foreclosures.
focusAreas.#eMortgage: A set of terms that refer to electronically signed closing documents paired with an original digital promissory note.
focusAreas.#iLAD: A set of terms that comprise the Industry Loan Application Dataset (iLAD).

termTypes.Actor: Represents an individual, entity, or system, or a collection of individuals or entities, or systems. They are often associated with a particular role in the mortgage process.
termTypes.Data: Represents data points as documented in the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD). It also includes items from a third party source (e.g., amounts, dates, calculations, rates, and numbers).
termTypes.Document: Record(s) of information, typically in written or digital form, that provides evidence, details, or context about a particular topic, event, or transaction (e.g., Uniform Residential Loan Application).
termTypes.Event: Thing that happens, especially one that is of importance (e.g., an act of God; accident; accretion). It occurs at a particular date or time period.
termTypes.Other: A category for terms that do not fall into one of the other defined category types.
termTypes.Outcome: The result of a process whether intended or unintended.
termTypes.Process: Represents an action, or actions, to be taken (e.g., Take Loan Application; Underwrite Loan; Close Loan; Origination). A process tends to occur over time.
termTypes.Product: Represents the characteristics of a financial instrument secured by property.
termTypes.Regulation: A rule or set of rules that control or govern a system, process, or behavior.

sources.Artificial Intelligence Glossary: A set of terms originating from the Artificial Intelligence Community of Practice published AI Glossary.
sources.Data Governance & Management CoP (DGM): A set of terms grouped by the MISMO Data Governance & Management (DGM) Community of Practice.
sources.LDD Acronym: A set of terms sourced from the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD) Approved Acronym List.
sources.LDD Attribute: A set of terms sourced from the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD) Attribute list.
sources.LDD Document: A set of terms sourced from the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD) Document Type Enumerations List.
sources.MBA Glossary: A set of terms included in the Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA) Business Glossary. Published on MISMO's site as “MBA Business Glossary”; the glossary data uses the shorter “MBA Glossary”.
sources.MISMO (Non-LDD): A set of terms originating from a MISMO source, including from other artifacts published by MISMO workgroups (e.g. white papers).
sources.MISMO Governing Documents: A set of terms derived from the MISMO Development Process Document (DPD), MISMO Policies and Procedures (P&P), or MISMO Intellectual Property Rights (IPR).
sources.MISMO Life of Loan: A set of terms grouped by the MISMO Life of Loan Business Process Model and Community of Practice.
sources.MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD): A set of terms that comprise the MISMO model.
sources.MISMO eMortgage: A set of terms that refer to electronically signed closing documents paired with an original digital promissory note.
